name: Liquid Languor #1
description:
A beverage contained in a dark blue bottle, reminiscent of premium bottled water. The label features a stylized droplet logo with soothing visual elements.

EFFECT: Induces a state of relaxation lasting approximately 30 minutes, with no lasting effects.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Temporarily induces a mild relaxation effect in the consumer.
TASTE: Subtly sweet with notes of chamomile and lavender.
PACKAGING: A sleek, dark blue bottle with a metallic sheen and minimalist font; label reads 'Liquid Languor'.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Could be useful for de-escalating tense meetings, though it might also turn them into nap time.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-06-21 — edition #1 of the permanent record.
